description: The maximum number of private certificate authorities (CAs) that can be created in an account in the current Region.

quota_name: Number of private certificates for each CA
description: The maximum number of private certificates that a certificate authority (CA) can issue in an account in the current Region. This quota applies when no revocation is enabled or revocation is enabled using partitioned CRL and/or OCSP. When complete CRL is enabled, the "Number of private certificates for each CA using complete CRLs" limit is applied.

quota_name: Number of private certificates for each CA using complete CRLs
description: The maximum number of private certificates that a certificate authority (CA) can issue in an account in the current Region. This quota applies to CAs using complete CRLs.

quota_name: Number of revoked private certificates for each CA with complete CRLs enabled
description: The maximum number of revoked, unexpired private certificates in an account in the current Region. This quota applies only to certificates issued when the CA had complete CRLs enabled.
